user.title: Plex Dashboard
user.description:
This will install the Plex Dashboard YAML files, register a Lovelace dashboard, and create the required helpers.

Detected Plex servers: {detected}

error.slug_required: A Plex server slug is required.
error.slug_invalid: Slug must be lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only.

abort.already_configured: Plex Dashboard is already set up.

confirm.title: Install {card}
confirm.description:
The Plex Dashboard requires the **{card}** frontend card.

Install it via HACS:

1. Open HACS → Frontend
2. Search for **{card}**
3. Install and reload your browser

Repository: `{repo}`

packages_not_loaded.title: Plex Dashboard: packages not enabled
packages_not_loaded.description:
The Plex Dashboard package was written to `/config/packages/plex_dashboard.yaml`, but it doesn't appear to be loaded.

Add this to your `configuration.yaml` and restart Home Assistant:

```yaml
homeassistant:
  packages: !include_dir_named packages
```
